official_definition: Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 30000 BP. Then, by sending two cores from any of your "Bashin Dan" Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, discard up to six cards from your decktop. If this effect discards any "Devotee"/"Astral Deity" family card, refresh this Spirit.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Solar Unleash] or [Solar Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Solar Unleash]", "give [Solar Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mills cards from opposing decktop to Grave.
